content.comment_body: 1 - Why are no changes visible in the data table during simulation when controlling the time block parameter using the Ethernet output? 2 - Does this indicate: a) an error in the simulator, or b) that it is not possible to update the block parameter via Ethernet output? For reference: a) The time parameter uses the 'on delay' entry, b) The time parameter is mapped in VM mapping at VW0, c) The word VW2 written with the same value reflects correctly.

As mentioned previously: Simulation does not always reflect real device behavior. Certain functionalities may not operate in the simulation but work on real hardware, while others might function in simulation but not on the actual device.

analysis.insight_summary: There is inconsistency between simulation and actual hardware for controlling time block parameters via Ethernet in [product_name] systems, notably when changes are not reflected in the data table during simulation. This uncertainty makes it challenging for users to confirm configuration changes without access to real hardware.
analysis.user_expectations: User expects that modifications to the time block parameter through Ethernet output should be visible in the data table during simulation, aligning with the behavior observed on physical devices.
